presentation.label: PAD SELECT
presentation.summary: With PAD+TRIG SEL TRK checked, the pads and TRIG keys 1-12 sound only in LIVE RECORDING; otherwise a press selects its track silently and FUNC + pad plays it.
presentation.overview: Pad Select adds PAD+TRIG SEL TRK to GLOBAL > SEQUENCER CONFIG, a checkbox after AUTO TRK SWITCH. Checked, a pad or TRIG key 1-12 makes sound only in LIVE RECORDING. Stopped, playing or in GRID RECORDING, a press selects its track and stays silent, with no MIDI note out; hold FUNC to play it, at the pad's own velocity. STEP RECORDING, CHROMATIC mode, MIDI notes in, TRIG + YES and the sequencer behave as stock. Unchecked, everything is stock. The setting is kept per GLOBAL slot and saved with the project.
highlights: Tap pads to pick tracks without hearing them.
FUNC + pad plays, at the pad's own velocity.
LIVE RECORDING and STEP RECORDING work as stock.
One checkbox per GLOBAL slot, saved with the project; unchecked is stock.
usage: Use a build containing Pad Select. Press SETTINGS, open GLOBAL > SEQUENCER CONFIG and check PAD+TRIG SEL TRK, just after AUTO TRK SWITCH, with YES or LEFT/RIGHT.
With the sequencer stopped, tap pad 3: it makes no sound and track 3 is selected. Hold FUNC and tap pad 3 to hear it, soft or hard. TRIG 5 selects track 5 the same way.
Press RECORD + PLAY for LIVE RECORDING: pads play and record as stock. Uncheck PAD+TRIG SEL TRK to get stock behaviour everywhere.

access.location: SETTINGS > GLOBAL > SEQUENCER CONFIG: PAD+TRIG SEL TRK, after AUTO TRK SWITCH.
steps: Press SETTINGS and open GLOBAL, then SEQUENCER CONFIG.
Move to PAD+TRIG SEL TRK, after AUTO TRK SWITCH, and press YES (or LEFT/RIGHT) to check it.

controls.name: PAD+TRIG SEL TRK
controls.doc: Checkbox in GLOBAL > SEQUENCER CONFIG, after AUTO TRK SWITCH. YES toggles it, RIGHT checks, LEFT unchecks. Checked: outside LIVE and STEP RECORDING, pads and TRIG keys 1-12 select their track silently and FUNC + press plays. Kept per GLOBAL slot.

controls.name: FUNC + pad, FUNC + TRIG 1-12
controls.doc: While PAD+TRIG SEL TRK applies, plays the track: a pad at its own velocity, a TRIG key at the track's VEL. In LIVE and STEP RECORDING, or unchecked, as stock.

limitations: Built for OS 1.74 only, with core-ar2 0.3.
Not yet run on a unit or in an emulator.
Live recording counts only while the sequencer runs: paused in LIVE RECORDING, pads select silently.
RTRG + pad outside live recording selects silently; FUNC + RTRG + pad rolls.
A GLOBAL slot saved without the setting, or received as Global SysEx, loads unchecked.

claims: ui:GLOBAL > SEQUENCER CONFIG row after AUTO TRK SWITCH

load.display: None in the audio path: a few compares per pad or TRIG key press
load.conditions: Static: the sites are in KeyboardView's pad and TRIG key handlers, their shared play routine and the SEQUENCER CONFIG menu's constructor; each press reads one storage bit and the record state. Nothing is added to the audio, sequencer or tick paths. Not a measurement.

tests.summary: Not run on a unit or in an emulator. Modwerk's linker builds it on stock OS 1.74 with core-ar2 0.3, alone and beside Filter Hz and Loop Sync; see TESTING.md.
